site.title: Himanshu Singh | Java Backend / Full Stack Engineer
site.description: Java Backend and Full Stack Engineer with 2+ years of experience in Spring Boot microservices, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, OpenShift, and React/Next.js. Portfolio and resume.

resume.headline: Java Backend / Full Stack Engineer
resume.headlineTrack: Java 17 · Spring Boot · Microservices · React / Next.js
resume.summary: Java Backend and Full Stack Engineer with 2+ years of experience building REST APIs, Spring Boot microservices, and real-time systems for CRM, logistics, and SaaS products. Strong in Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, and AWS, with production experience on OpenShift and Jenkins CI/CD and frontend delivery in React and Next.js. Test-driven with JUnit, Mockito, and Postman; additional experience in Go (Gin) and the MERN stack.

workExperience.stack: Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Next.js, Maven, Swagger, Log4j, OpenShift, Jenkins, Agile/Scrum
bullets: Built and maintained Java 17 / Spring Boot microservices behind a Spring Cloud API Gateway, with Hibernate persistence on PostgreSQL and MySQL, Swagger / OpenAPI documented REST contracts, and structured Log4j logging; built with Maven in Agile / Scrum sprints.

Designed a concurrent-editing protection mechanism (version-based optimistic locking with conflict detection at the database layer) for collaborative workflows, cutting conflicting updates by 80% and preserving data integrity.

Reduced average API response time by 40% (500 ms to 300 ms) by moving heavy work to asynchronous processing and Spring Batch jobs with scheduled triggers for large-volume report calculation, and by tuning Hibernate queries and database indexes.
Integrated third-party vendor systems over REST, handling authentication, request/response mapping, retries, and error handling to keep vendor workflows reliable.

Automated build and deployment pipelines with Jenkins CI/CD deploying to OpenShift, halving deployment time from 20 min to 10 min; wrote JUnit 5 / Mockito unit and integration tests, maintained Postman regression collections, and reviewed pull requests.

workExperience.stack: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Gradle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Jenkins, Log4j, JUnit, Mockito, Agile
bullets: Designed and scaled RESTful microservices in Java / Spring Boot with Hibernate, built with Gradle, for CRM and logistics workflows, owning inter-service communication and data-consistency guarantees across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB stores.
Improved API latency by 30–40% and cut database load by ~35% through SQL query optimization, MongoDB indexing, and Redis caching.
Built real-time, event-driven features over WebSockets for logistics conversations and live shipment updates.

Developed chat-based logistics coordination workflows with secure storage of bills and quotes on AWS S3; maintained Jenkins pipelines, Log4j logging, JUnit / Mockito unit tests, and Postman API contract checks as part of each release.
Mentored an engineering intern, onboarding them to the codebase and current workflows, reviewing their code, and guiding feature delivery in an Agile team tracked in ClickUp.
Built and optimized Node.js / Express.js REST APIs backed by MongoDB for order and product management, improving response time by ~30%; tested endpoints with Postman.
Implemented cron-based notification and automated email workflows, reducing manual operational effort by ~40%; developed React frontend components.

projects.title: HireFlow — Talent Acquisition Platform
projects.stack: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud API Gateway, Eureka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, WebRTC, Log4j, JUnit, Mockito, Next.js
bullets: Architected a scalable multi-tenant ATS with strong tenant isolation and smooth onboarding.
Spring Boot microservices routed through a Spring Cloud API Gateway with Eureka service discovery; PostgreSQL for structured data and MongoDB for flexible schemas.
Real-time video interviews via WebRTC and WebSocket signaling; Razorpay for payments.
Redis caching for faster responses and better overall performance.
Services unit-tested with JUnit and Mockito, REST APIs verified through Postman collections, and structured Log4j logging across services.

projects.tagline: Full-stack geofencing and fleet tracking: Go + PostGIS API, JWT auth, WebSocket alerts, Next.js dashboard, Dockerized deployment.
projects.title: Geofencing & Vehicle Tracking Platform — Personal / Portfolio
projects.summary: Full-stack application for defining geographic boundaries, tracking vehicles, and detecting zone violations. Backend exposes a REST API with JWT authentication, spatial data in PostGIS, and real-time alert delivery over WebSockets; frontend is a Next.js dashboard for geofences, fleet vehicles, alert configuration, and violation history. Packaged for deployment with multi-stage Docker builds and an optional single-container image running API and UI together.
projects.stack: Go, PostgreSQL + PostGIS, Next.js (TypeScript), REST API, WebSockets, JWT auth, Docker & Docker Compose
bullets: Architected and implemented a Go HTTP API with PostgreSQL/PostGIS for spatial geofences and vehicle location storage, including SQL migrations applied on startup.
Built JWT-based authentication and protected REST routes for geofences, vehicles, location ingestion, alert configuration, and violation history.
Implemented WebSocket-based live alerts so the dashboard receives geofence violations in real time.
Developed a Next.js dashboard for managing geofences, vehicles, and alerts, integrated with the API and WebSocket endpoints.
Added rate limiting on vehicle location updates (configurable sliding window) to protect the API from abuse or noisy clients.

projects.tagline: Full-stack food ordering app: Spring Boot REST API (JWT, JPA, MySQL) and React SPA (Redux Toolkit, MUI) with customer ordering and restaurant admin workflows.
projects.title: Online Food Ordering Platform | Full-Stack Web Application
projects.summary: Full-stack food delivery–style application where customers browse restaurants and menus, manage a cart and addresses, and place orders; restaurant operators use an admin area for menus, categories, ingredients, orders, and roles. The backend exposes a secured REST API with JWT-based auth; the SPA consumes it with Redux-managed state and role-based routing for customer vs. admin experiences.
projects.stack: Java 17, Spring Boot 3, Spring Security, JWT, Spring Data JPA, MySQL, REST APIs, Maven · React 19, Redux Toolkit, React Router, Axios, Material UI, Formik, Yup, i18next, Tailwind CSS, Create React App
bullets: Implemented JWT authentication, password hashing, and protected API routes on Spring Boot; integrated the React app via Axios and token handling (e.g. persistence / refresh of session client-side).
Modeled relational data (users, restaurants, menu items, cart, orders, addresses, payments) with JPA/Hibernate and MySQL; exposed consistent REST resources with DTOs and centralized error handling.

Built a React customer flow (discovery, restaurant details, cart, checkout-related UI, profile: orders, favorites, addresses) and an admin dashboard for restaurant, menu, category, ingredient, and order management.
Used Redux Toolkit for modular state (auth, restaurants, menu, cart, orders, ingredients, restaurant-side orders) and React Router for separate admin and customer route trees.
Delivered a responsive UI with Material UI, theming, and supporting libraries (Formik/Yup for forms, i18n where configured); documented API usage (e.g. Postman collection on backend).

projects.title: ChatApp — Real-Time Messaging Platform (Full-stack | Personal / Portfolio)
projects.summary: Full-stack chat application with direct and group messaging, live delivery/read receipts, typing indicators, JWT authentication with email verification, and WebRTC signaling—built with Spring Boot, MongoDB, Next.js, and WebSocket/STOMP.
projects.stack: Spring Boot, Spring Security, MongoDB, WebSocket/STOMP, JWT, Log4j, JUnit, Mockito, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Docker, Resend, WebRTC
bullets: Architected and implemented a REST + WebSocket (STOMP/SockJS) backend in Java 17 / Spring Boot with JWT securing HTTP and WebSocket handshakes.
Designed MongoDB data models for users, chats, and messages; used a deterministic direct-chat key with unique indexing to prevent duplicate 1:1 threads under concurrency.
Built a Next.js (React + TypeScript) client with real-time UI updates, paginated message history, unread counts, optimistic sends, and group management flows.
Implemented end-to-end message lifecycle states (SENT → DELIVERED → READ) synchronized between persistence, realtime events, and UI indicators.
Added email verification for registration; integrated Resend (HTTPS API) for production email delivery where cloud SMTP ports are blocked, with SMTP fallback for local development.
Integrated WebRTC call flows by reusing the existing STOMP channel for signaling (invite/offer/answer/ICE/hangup).
Core services covered by JUnit / Mockito tests with Log4j logging for observability.
